cases.selection_reason: Predeclared reference case retained regardless of evidence coverage. It intentionally stress-tests the strict ex-ante evidence boundary and the PARTIAL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE path instead of dropping a difficult case post hoc.

Predeclared reference case with full slot coverage. It provides a stable, evidence-rich counterpart to the low-coverage anchor and allows redesign comparisons without selecting cases after seeing Stage 1 outputs.
Coverage-qualified representative of the large-gap/steep-slope regime. Selected before Stage 1 generation using only frozen Stage 0 forecast/evidence metadata.
Coverage-qualified representative of the large-gap/moderate-slope regime, included to separate persistent structural imbalance from rapidly accelerating imbalance.
Coverage-qualified representative of the moderate-gap/steep-slope regime, included to test whether agents distinguish emerging escalation from already-large gaps.
Coverage-qualified representative of the moderate-gap/low-slope regime, included as a managed/stable trajectory rather than another escalation-heavy example.
Coverage-qualified representative of the small-gap/low-or-negative-slope regime, included as a low-risk alignment control against high-gap and accelerating cases.

regime_definitions.large_gap_moderate_slope: mean_gap >= gap_Q75 and slope_Q25 <= slope < slope_Q75
regime_definitions.moderate_gap_low_slope: gap_Q25 < mean_gap < gap_Q75 and slope_Q25 <= slope < slope_Q50
regime_definitions.moderate_gap_steep_slope: gap_Q25 < mean_gap < gap_Q75 and slope >= slope_Q75

selection_constraints: Stage 1 outputs are never used for case selection.
Two predeclared anchors are always retained, including low-evidence cases.
Five additional cases cover five distinct gap/slope regimes.
Regime representatives must cover at least 5 of 6 evidence slots and at least 4 source families.
The case set is frozen before main Stage 1 generation and is not re-selected from downstream results.
